name: MyHealthEuException
title: MyHealth@EU exception code names
description: The exception code names of the MyHealth@EU Requirements Catalogue 10.0.0 §1.25 that a FerroFED gateway names in the details of an OperationOutcome on its FHIR face. The catalogue defines the names and publishes no code system URI, so they travel under this one; it lists the names the gateway uses.
